01 / LOCAL ANALYSIS

Learn from the recent past

A rolling median and median absolute deviation model uses up to 14 prior readings. Values over 4.5 deviations are flagged. The first 7 readings build the baseline.

02 / PORTABLE EVIDENCE

Catch changes after export

Each record links to the preceding fingerprint. Verification checks every link, recomputes analysis and compares against your separately retained root.

03 / HONEST LIMITS

Integrity is not truth

A valid chain shows data has not changed relative to a trusted root. It cannot prove a sensor was accurate. This is a local prototype, without public blockchain anchoring.
